profile.headline: Software Developer at North American Risk Services
profile.summary: Software Developer with 15+ years of experience developing Windows and Web applications with SQL and Oracle databases. Development and Solution Delivery supervisor with experience in Waterfall and Agile methodologies, Scrum Master.

positions.title: Software Engineer Lvl 2 at Lockheed Martin RMS
positions.description:
	Migration of ASP NET Web applications to the cloud (AWS) using container technology of Pivotal Cloud Foundry. 
	Worked on web application and windows service enhancements, maintenance, documentation, test support and deployment coordination to production.
	Application and process documentation. Contribution to company’s Confluence library with two new “How To Articles” to serve as references for fellow engineers.
	Began training in NET Core applications with Angular JS.

positions.title: Professional Applications Developer & External Vendor Coordinator
positions.description:
	In charge of the outsourced developers’ team. Responsible of interviewing, training, support, supervision and evaluation of team members.
	Lead programmer in Web and Desktop applications, including legacy apps and APIs, for a distributed system using MS Visual Studio, SQL Server, Oracle and Access with different programming languages (VB.NET, ASP.NET, C, C++, C#, Java), JavaScript, SQL. Analysis, troubleshooting, bug fixes, incident support.
	Worked on SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), ETL. 
	Design, planning, management and execution of all major projects such as application development and maintenance, integration with database systems, API and DB migrations and upgrades, data center relocations, using Agile methodology and Scrum.
	Architecture, capacity planning and resource management for all applications. 
	Developed a web tool to validate performance of the most important applications in the company that need to be available 24/7. The tool allowed support personnel to quickly assess the impact of an incident and where to escalate among local and/or shared services or external vendors 
	Alternated with Solution Delivery Supervisor role and hands on programming and troubleshooting when necessary, on web and windows applications, using tools such as MS Visual Studio 2008 & 2012, MS SQL Server 2000, 2005 & 2008, Oracle 11 & 12, Access, Visio, Project, Power Point, Visual Source Safe, SubVersion (SVN)
	Service Request, Incident, Problem & Change Management. Help Desk hands on support with analysis, troubleshooting, bug fixes and incident resolution.

positions.title: Solution Delivery Supervisor
positions.description:
	Management of the developer and reporting teams. Delivered solutions as project supervisor.
	Lead programmer in Web and Desktop applications in the company, including legacy apps and APIs, for a distributed system using MS Visual Studio, SQL Server, Oracle and Access with different programming languages (VB.NET, ASP.NET, C, C++, C#, Java), JavaScript, SQL, SSIS, SSRS and ETL optimization and maintenance.
	Worked with procurements to manage team capacity, performance assessments, vendor compliance.
	Created a satellite application (CSR Portal) to be used in regional offices and Call Centers (PR & Colombia) that allowed CSRs to perform various tasks that were more complex or had more steps in the core CRM application, allowing a faster and more efficient service to customers with less human errors.
	Service Request, Incident, Problem & Change Management. Help Desk hands on support with analysis, troubleshooting, bug fixes and incident resolution.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
	Analysis, Design, Development and Implementation of custom NET Windows and Web applications and services for the internal users of the different departments of the company such as Billing, Customer Service, Customer Care, Accounting, Sales, Marketing, Warehouse and Field Operations, using databases Informix, SQL Server, Oracle.
	Development of web application and web services for external customer use such as individuals or third parties for payments, programming package changes and personal data and address modification.
	Development of in-house applications for the execution or automation of Invoicing, Payment processing, Commissions, Inventory, Customer Creation, Customer Rewards, Customer Service, IVR and other needs.
	Development of integration interfaces between custom applications and core business application CRM (IBS – Win App, DB Informix)
	Maintenance of legacy apps (Access, Desktop Apps) and Reports Portal.
	Help Desk support.
	Created a PPV application that could be used by any employee or guest with little or no experience in the company, during high traffic hours, that performed a risk analysis (transparent to the user) before allowing a customer to activate a PPV event. The functionality was also available for SMS activation with a third party via web services.

positions.title: Programmer - Analyst
positions.description:
	Designed and developed a WEB application for car loans, interacting with Oracle to analyze consumer scores for a financial institution.
	Developed a NET application for the monitoring and displaying of real time vehicle data, interconnected with a GPS System.
	Modification of an application to create custom built queries to an Oracle Database using JSP.
	Design, development and implementation of Win32 applications and web services, interacting with SQL Server. Troubleshooting and bug fixes.

positions.title: Applications/Web Developer
positions.description:
	Designed and developed a WEB application for car loans, interacting with Oracle to analyze consumer scores for a financial institution.
	Developed a NET application for the monitoring and displaying of real time vehicle data, interconnected with a GPS System.
	Modification of an application to create custom built queries to an Oracle Database using JSP.
	Design, development and implementation of Win32 applications and web services, interacting with SQL Server. Troubleshooting and bug fixes.
